title: A new video starts from an empty timeline
goal: The video mock starts from nothing: a blank 1920 by 1080 timeline with an empty V1 and an empty Audio track, then the Library is filled and a first tile dragged onto a track. Today a document only has a timeline once a recording is in it, so a video cannot be started the way the mock shows.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html onboarding step 1 (New, empty, line ~325) and its stage (line ~686: A 1920 x 1080 timeline with no clips. Import media, or open a capture from history, to begin). PhotonzDocument.hasTime is durationMS != nil || a layer occupies time (Sources/PhotonzCore/DocumentTime.swift), so a blank document with durationMS set would already have a timeline; File > New Blank Canvas... is the nearest existing path (Experiments.blankCanvasEnabled). The Library half landed in recordings-and-sounds-can-go-into-the-library-wi (File > Import Media, Shift Command I; shelf drop; header plus).
acceptance: A person running Next can make a new, empty video (size and length chosen, nothing on it) from the File menu
It opens with an empty V1 and an empty Audio track under a ruler, and the Library ready for Import
Dragging a Library tile onto its empty V1 lands the first clip, and the length grows to fit
A walk at Next defaults does the whole of it: new empty video, Import, drag the tile onto V1
